parts.name: Replacement blades, 54 in deck (RYRM8003)
parts.notes: 54 in deck only. The 42 in 80V models (RYRM8002/RYRM8021) use different blades that aren't covered by these manuals, so check your model label first. Blade nut takes a 15 mm socket, torque 600-650 in-lb (p.24).

parts.name: CrossCut replacement blades, 54 in deck (RYRM8003)
parts.notes: Upper/lower CrossCut blade pair for the 54 in deck. Install the lower blade with its curved ends pointing up toward the deck (p.24).

parts.name: Combo blades (mulch + side discharge), 42 in RY48ZTR75/100
parts.notes: For the 48V RY48ZTR75/RY48ZTR100 42 in deck only. Blade nut takes a 15 mm socket, torque 600-650 in-lb (p.23).

parts.name: Bagger blades, 42 in RY48ZTR75/100
parts.notes: Use with the ACRM005 bagging kit.

parts.name: Bagging kit (bagger assembly + bagger blades), 42 in RY48ZTR75/100
12V lead-acid battery, RY48ZTR75/100 (x4 in series)
parts.notes: 48V models only. Four 12V batteries run in series. Replace them as an identical matched set and never mix makes or sizes (p.26).

parts.name: Main fuse, 100A 70V (80V ZTR junction box)

oem.source: TTI RYOBI 80V ZTR Troubleshooting Guide (2022-07-19), 'Testing Main Fuse'

parts.notes: Rating only. The guide gives no part number, so replace with the same physical size, amps and volts, and find the cause of the blown fuse first. It sits in the junction box. Source: https://servicedocs.ttibrands.com.au/assets/Uploads/docs/RYOBI-80V-ZTR-Troubleshooting-Guide-2022.07.19-1.pdf

parts.name: DC-DC converter fuse, 4A automotive blade (80V ZTR)

oem.source: TTI RYOBI 80V ZTR Troubleshooting Guide (2022-07-19), 'Testing DC-DC Convertor Fuse'

parts.notes: Rating only, no part number given. It sits next to the 80V-to-12V DC-DC converter, and a blown one means lights and 12V controls go dead.
